propositions: Rewrite the T5c security criterion with a criterion-local GROUNDING OVERRIDE that grounds security implications in the current codebase and configuration via read tools, so a control defined elsewhere flips a finding.
Add a dedup-at-source rule capping undeclared-access-posture findings at one per plan, folding extra surfaces into that finding's evidence.
Demote candidate findings that cite neither a read repo artifact nor a quoted plan sentence to minor severity rather than suppressing them.
Scope severity so only two HIGH classes (plaintext secret on a boundary-crossing path; undeclared internet-reachable sensitive surface) warrant major or above.
Change the T5c routing entry to default_posture blocking at block_threshold 0.9, without adding the inert blocking_enabled key, leaving passes.py and prompts.py untouched.
The grounding change is criterion-local so it stays correct regardless of where the shared preamble lives, avoiding conflict with the concurrent preamble relocation.
